details:
When browsing the Worlds menu, the current player counter shows the total amount of players across all instances of a world (public/private), which can be used as an indicator of the world's current popularity. The more players are in a given world, the more likely that it's worth checking out.
However, when your purpose is to find worlds with populated public instances, this total player number becomes much less useful. It's not uncommon to see a world with 50 players on the menu, click it, and discover that all of them are in private instances that you have no access to. If you're looking to meet people, then the total player counter may as well have been 0 in that case.
Thanks to a recent update, we can now see how many players are in public & private instances of a world, but only after bringing up that world's details. I propose that a toggle be implemented on the root Worlds menu to allow us to switch between displaying the total amount of players in a world, and the total amount of players in public instances.
title: Allow us to toggle between displaying the total players in all instances and the total players in public instances
